name: octaweave_get_post
description: Fetch one post by id or slug: markdown `body`, rendered `html`, `version`, and `media` — the drive files the post displays together with whether a logged-out reader can actually see each one. CHECK `media` BEFORE PUBLISHING anything with images: a broken image is invisible to the author, who is signed in, and only 404s for readers.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.
